explication: LEAN is an event-driven algorithmic trading engine for backtesting and live trading across multiple markets. A developer submits an algorithm job; the engine assembles pluggable handlers, creates and initializes the algorithm, streams market data, and routes algorithm orders through transaction handling to a brokerage. Fills update portfolio state and results. The repository also documents modular strategy models, alternative/custom data, options and futures support, object storage, Python integration, and brokerage-recovery messaging. Some subsystem links are inferred only from documented interfaces because sampled source is partial.
